_note: SYNTHETIC benchmark for goal matching (Stage 8). Needs are written as a teacher or psychologist would phrase them, deliberately not copying the goal bank wording. 'expected' lists every starter-set goal code (app/data/goal_bank_seed.json) that counts as a correct match. Written by the development team; must be reviewed and extended by the SNED Coordinator.
